description: Measures GPU cache/memory latency via single-thread cacheline-stride pointer chasing over a random Hamiltonian cycle (one node per cacheline, so every access is a fresh line). array_bytes (the working-set size) selects the targeted level: small sizes stay resident in L1/L2, mid sizes spill to MALL/Infinity Cache, large sizes to DRAM. The cold fill lap is run UNTIMED and discarded (an untimed warm-up makes the set resident and loads the code object), so only steady-state laps are timed: timed accesses = clamp(measure_laps * array_bytes/cacheline_bytes, floor, ceiling). Resident sizes therefore measure pure hits (no cold-miss bias on L1/L2/MALL) and larger sizes measure all-miss DRAM latency, with the timed count bounded so every point runs in seconds. Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of kernel times); latency in nanoseconds per access is derived downstream from time_ms and num_accesses.

scaling_param.name: array_bytes
scaling_param.description: Working-set size in bytes; selects which level (L1/L2/MALL/DRAM) serves the chase

non_scaling_params.name: cacheline_bytes
non_scaling_params.description: Stride between chase nodes; set to the cacheline size so each access hits a fresh line (64 B on gfx942/MI300X)

non_scaling_params.name: measure_laps
non_scaling_params.description: Number of TIMED steady-state laps (the cold fill lap is run untimed and excluded); clamped to a min/max so tiny sizes get enough samples and the DRAM end stays bounded
